value.rationale: The exact necessary-and-sufficient nodal positivity threshold for layered diffusion coefficients, including its independence from contrast and cell number and the sharp four-cell exception, closes a structurally motivated gap between sufficient Stieltjes criteria and practical monotonicity in a heterogeneous medium. The result covers an infinite family rather than a finite table or routine single-case calculation.
